parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Quantity of the package to purchase.

parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto payment.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Auto-renewal:
- true: Enable auto-renewal.
- false: Disable auto-renewal.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   PREPAY: subscription.
*   POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: Coverage
parameters.description:
The service location. Valid values:

*   domestic: the Chinese mainland.
*   global: global.
*   overseas: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The DNS setup option for the website. Valid values:

*   NS
*   CNAME

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa purchase-rate-plan --plan-name basic --plan-code basicplan --site-name test.com --coverage domestic --type CNAME --auto-renew true --period 1 --charge-type PREPAY --auto-pay true --amount 1 --channel xxxWodkxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa PurchaseRatePlan --region cn-hangzhou --Type CNAME --SiteName 'test.com' --PlanCode basicplan --ChargeType PREPAY --AutoRenew true --Amount 1 --Channel xxxWodkxxx --Period 1 --Coverage domestic --AutoPay true --PlanName basic
